definition: a politician running for public office
description: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

taps.phrase: to be lifted by her supporters
to show a rising bar chart
